summary: This sermon explores how believers can unite around the gospel while humbly navigating theological disagreements. Using 1 Corinthians 8-10 as the primary text, the preacher argues that Christians must prioritize love and the gospel over being right about secondary doctrines, recognizing that all believers have blind spots and are at different stages of spiritual development.
key_points: We all have theological blind spots and need humility to recognize them
Scripture should be weighed by its proximity to revealing Jesus, the supreme revelation
Knowledge without love puffs up; we must prioritize building others up over asserting our rights
Spiritual maturity involves recognizing we can be adults in some areas and infants in others
Unity requires laying down preferences for the sake of weaker consciences and the gospel mission
big_idea: Christians must unite around Jesus and the essential gospel truths while humbly laying down their rights and preferences on secondary matters for the sake of love, community, and the kingdom of God.
title: Sunday @ Canvas Community Church
